# parity-fuzz --mode subexp baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode subexp --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# This mode pins UNQUOTED nested `${${...}[...]}` value semantics (a
# double-quoted inner collapses to a scalar before the outer subscript — a
# separate DQ-collapse concern excluded from this mode).
#
# STRICT GATE — zero known gaps. All previously-baselined classes are FIXED:
#   - `${${(P)assoc}[key]}` assoc-key lookup;
#   - `${#${subexp}[N]}` subscript-under-length;
#   - nested bare-assoc value-splat shape (`${${h}}`, `${(@)${h}}`);
#   - `(P)`-assoc `[@]`/`[*]` splat (`${${(P)h}[@]}`);
#   - `${#${emptyarray}[lo,hi]}` empty-array slice length (getarrvalue nular
#     padding, c:params.c:2570-2585 — the empty array now stays array-shaped
#     through the nesting so the outer slice pads correctly).
# Any new divergence here fails CI.
